candidates.evidence: Three sp2-carbon bands: D 1344.2 cm-1 (FWHM 15.2), G 1579.3 cm-1 (FWHM 14.3), 2D 2689.8 cm-1 (FWHM 32.4, single Lorentzian; a second component is not significant, F=1.6). I2D/IG = 3.0 by height (6.8 by area). Monolayer-like 2D shape and intensity ratio. Weak D' shoulder at ~1620 cm-1 (F=26) gives ID/ID' ~6-10. No Si or SiO2 bands are inside the measured window.

Bilayer would give a multi-component, broader 2D band (typically ~50 cm-1 FWHM) and I2D/IG near or below 1-2. Here the 2D is a single 32 cm-1 Lorentzian with I2D/IG = 3, so this is disfavoured but not fully excluded by one spectrum.
Disordered carbon would show very broad D and G bands with G near 1590-1600 cm-1 and no sharp 2D. The narrow 14-15 cm-1 D and G widths and the sharp 2D argue strongly against it.

hint_reasoning: No material hint was given (material_hint is null). The identification rests only on the spectrum: the G/2D/D pattern at 532 nm, the 2D line shape and I2D/IG ratio, and the absence of the characteristic substrate lines within 1100-3000 cm-1.

peaks.assignment: D band (defect-activated breathing mode at K)
peaks.source: Assignment: Tuinstra & Koenig, J. Chem. Phys. 53, 1126 (1970); Ferrari & Basko, Nat. Nanotechnol. 8, 235 (2013). Position and FWHM from Lorentzian fit (centre ±0.2 cm-1). Height 2589 counts, area ~6.2e4.

peaks.assignment: G band (in-plane sp2 C-C stretch, Gamma point)
peaks.source: Assignment: Ferrari et al., PRL 97, 187401 (2006); Ferrari & Basko 2013. Position ±0.1 cm-1 from fit. Height 5340 counts, area ~1.2e5. Position is ~2-3 cm-1 below the ~1582 cm-1 pristine reference, which is not diagnostic of doping or strain on its own.

peaks.assignment: D' band (defect-activated intravalley mode near Gamma)
peaks.source: Assignment: Eckmann et al., Nano Lett. 12, 3925 (2012); Lucchese et al., Carbon 48, 1592 (2010). Weak shoulder on G: height ~250-420 counts depending on background model; position uncertain to ~±1-3 cm-1. Significance F~26 vs no-D' model.

peaks.assignment: 2D band (second-order overtone of D, double resonance at K)
peaks.source: Assignment and monolayer shape criteria: Ferrari et al., PRL 97, 187401 (2006); Ferrari & Basko 2013. Position ±0.04 cm-1 from fit. Height 15929 counts, area ~8.1e5, single Lorentzian.

properties.name: layers
properties.source: I2D/IG = 3.0 (height), single 32 cm-1 Lorentzian 2D band; monolayer criteria per Ferrari et al., PRL 97, 187401 (2006).

properties.name: defect_level
properties.source: ID/IG = 0.49 (height) / 0.52 (area) at 532 nm, giving L_D ~17 nm (>10 nm, isolated-defect regime). Borderline: the ID/IG value alone could be read as medium. Cancado et al., Nano Lett. 11, 3190 (2011).

properties.name: L_D_nm
properties.source: L_D^2 = (1.8±0.5)e-9 * lambda^4 / (ID/IG) with lambda = 532 nm, ID/IG = 0.49-0.52 -> L_D = 16.7-17.2 nm. Range from the ±0.5e-9 coefficient uncertainty. Cancado et al., Nano Lett. 11, 3190 (2011). Implied defect density ~1e11 cm-2 using n_D = 1e14/(pi L_D^2).

properties.name: defect_type
properties.value: vacancy-like or mixed (ID/ID' ~ 6-10); sp3 (~13) not excluded; boundary (~3.5) disfavoured
properties.source: ID/ID' ratio values from Lucchese et al., Carbon 48, 1592 (2010) and Eckmann et al., Nano Lett. 12, 3925 (2012). Low confidence: the D' band is weak and its height varies from ~250 to ~420 counts with the background model.

properties.name: strain_sign
properties.value: none detected (not resolvable from a single spectrum)
properties.source: G at 1579.3 cm-1 and 2D at 2689.8 cm-1 do not fit a simple strain signature. No calibration was applied to separate strain from doping.

properties.name: doping_type
properties.value: none detected (not resolvable from a single spectrum)
properties.source: G position is slightly low relative to the ~1582 cm-1 pristine reference. Without a G/2D doping-strain calibration (Lee et al., Nat. Commun. 3, 1024 (2012)) the sign cannot be established.

properties.name: substrate
properties.value: SiO2/Si as stated in metadata; not verified
properties.source: Measurement metadata. The Si 520.7 cm-1 line and the Si second-order band lie outside the measured 1100-3000 cm-1 window, so the substrate could not be checked from this spectrum.

limits: Single spot, single spectrum, no polarisation data. Only the material and defect character at that spot can be stated, not the whole flake.

L_D uses the empirical Cancado (2011) relation at 532 nm with ID/IG ~0.5. The stated range is only the coefficient uncertainty; the formula itself has roughly ±20-30% systematic uncertainty. The older crystallite-size relation L_a = 2.4e-10 lambda^4/(ID/IG) (Cancado 2006) gives ~40 nm, a different quantity, so it was not used for L_D.

The D' band is weak (~250-420 counts over a ~1000-1500 count background). Its amplitude depends on the background model, so ID/ID' (6-10) and the defect-type call are low confidence. Boundaries (~3.5) are disfavoured; vacancy-like (~7) versus sp3 (~13) cannot be cleanly separated.
The D-band origin (point defects versus edges) cannot be separated from one spot. L_D assumes defect-activated scattering.
A bilayer or few-layer admixture under the spot cannot be fully excluded. The 2D band is well described by one Lorentzian (second component F~1.6, not significant), and I2D/IG ~3 fits monolayer.
Doping and strain cannot be separated from G and 2D positions alone. No calibration was applied.
The Si 520.7 cm-1 line and SiO2 bands lie outside 1100-3000 cm-1, so substrate lines are not in the data and the SiO2/Si substrate could not be verified.
A feature near 1168 cm-1 found in the first pass was a baseline edge effect and disappeared with a smooth background. It is not reported as a peak.

No cosmic-ray spikes were confirmed. The largest single-pixel excess (2181.25 cm-1, ~+580 counts, ~3.9 sigma against noise of ~140 counts) is consistent with noise and not reported. Several 3.3-sigma single-pixel excursions also exist.
A broad background (~1000-1600 counts, with a hump near 1850 cm-1) is not assigned. It may be luminescence, substrate, or residue, and cannot be identified from this data.
No peak was assigned for D+D'' near 2450 cm-1; the largest residual there is a single-pixel 3-sigma excess, not a band.
Temperature is given as 295 K; no laser-heating correction could be determined from the data.
